tieu_de: AI  IT Specialist Business Analyst, ERP, RPA, SQL
ten_cong_ty: Công ty TNHH Schoeller-Bleckmann Việt Nam
dia_chi_raw: Lô B2.6, Đường D3, KCN Đồng An 2, TP. Thủ Dầu Một, Bình Dương
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Gather, analyze, and clarify business requirements from different departments.
Review existing processes to identify bottlenecks, repetitive tasks, operational issues, and automation opportunities.
Analyze relationships and dependencies across business processes, data, departments, ERP modules, and integrated systems.
Prepare business and system documentation, including BRDs, User Stories, Use Cases, Process Flows, and Acceptance Criteria.
Propose process improvements using AI, AI Agents, Workflow Automation, RPA, or other appropriate technologies.
Work as Developers, AI Engineers, Data Engineers throughout solution design, development, and implementation.
Record, analyze, track, and coordinate issue resolution until completion.
Train, guide, and support end users during implementation and daily operations.
Prepare User Manuals, Quick Guides, FAQs, and process documentation.
Collect post-implementation feedback, monitor solution effectiveness, and recommend continuous improvements.
AI Adoption & User Support: Support employees in using approved AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI solutions.
AI Governance & Compliance: Ensure AI usage complies with company policies, information security requirements, confidentiality obligations, and data privacy regulations.
AI Adoption Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor AI adoption, usage trends, business benefits, and prepare periodic reports for management.
Regional / Group AI Coordination: Act as the primary liaison with Group/Regional AI Teams for AI initiatives, projects, training programs, and best-practice sharing.
IT & Digital Transformation Projects: Participate in IT and Digital Transformation projects, software implementation, testing, training, and project documentation.
Ensuring the strictest and highest confidentiality is adhered to at all times
Ensuring all compliance and ethical practices are fully adhered to
yeu_cau:
a. Background /qualification:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
b. Experience:
Minimum 5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, ERP implementation, Digital Transformation, or Process Improvement projects.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand end-to-end relationships among processes, data, users, and systems.
Ability to perform root-cause analysis and assess the impact of changes across departments, processes, and system modules.
Experience in business documentation, software testing, UAT, user training, and end-user support.
Ability to prepare clear, logical, and user-friendly documentation.
Basic knowledge of SQL, APIs, system integration, and software testing.
Understanding of, or a strong willingness to learn, AI, AI Agents, Generative AI, RPA, and Workflow Automation.
Strong communication, presentation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.
c. Special skills:
Experience in AI, AI Agent, Chatbot, OCR, RPA, or process automation projects.
Hands-on experience with Power Automate, Power BI, Microsoft Copilot
Experience in user training, post-Go-live system support, and operational support.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Knowledge of data analytics, dashboards, or Power BI is an advantage.
